extractionProvider: Tavily advanced exact-page extraction plus source-faithful Exa recovery
notes: This batch covers King/queen of the Wild through Menacing Brute.
Tavily exact-page extraction covered all 75 records; Exa recovery tightened omitted prerequisite blocks and duplicate-source distinctions.
Same-name source variants remain independent, especially Knight of the Chalice, Master of Shrouds and Meditant.
No record was promoted to mechanically complete without reviewed automation and regression evidence.
